label: DEMO DATA - synthetic evaluation set. Fictional people, accounts and handles. Not real customer data.
notes: Written on 2026-10-12 by a session that had read the v1 scenario texts (evaluation/scam_dna/scenarios_v1.json) but NOT the regular expressions in backend/app/scamdna/tactics.py or backend/app/detector/rules.py. Labels and acceptable outcomes were fixed before the detector was run on any of these scenarios. Domains use .example; UPI handles start with 'eval'. Brand names appear only inside text that impersonates them, as real scam messages do. Not used to tune any rule.

outcomes.clear: risk level low and review_required false
outcomes.review: risk level low and review_required true

labels.scam: a fraud attempt; the positive class
labels.ambiguous: a reasonable analyst could not decide from the evidence; scored only against its acceptable outcomes, never in precision/recall
labels.integration: malformed or edge input; scored only against its expected API behaviour

event_kinds.upi: POST /upi/check with case_id (input = UPI ID or the upi:// text a QR code decodes to; QR images are decoded in the browser, so the API only ever sees this text)
event_kinds.screenshot: the text is rendered to a PNG locally and sent to POST /forensics/screenshot with case_id (local Tesseract OCR)
event_kinds.blank_screenshot: a PNG with no text sent to POST /forensics/screenshot
